You are implementing one step of an approved spec in this git repository.
Document 1 is the spec (pinned revision 0193f0c4-1b2a-7c3d-9e8f-001122334455). Documents 2–3 are the docs it links to and the docs the project marks as always relevant, read at the same commit. Use the documents as context; the step below defines the work.

Task: tasks-done/s1 — Add a `done` command to the CLI store
Acceptance criteria for this step:
- AC-01: `tasks done <id>` marks the task done.
- AC-02: Unknown ids exit with code 2.
Done when (run these and make them pass before you finish):
- `cd cli && go test ./...`
- `make lint`

Environment:
- Ports: 41000–41002 (SAKA_PORT_BASE, SAKA_PORT_COUNT, PORT)
- Toolchains: go 1.26.2, node 26.13.0
- Secrets available as environment variables: TEST_API_KEY

Rules:
- Work only inside this repository.
- Commit all your changes with a Conventional Commits message before you finish.
- Do not push. Saka pushes the branch and opens the pull request.
